undated_mentions: Amateur footballer for Figline; failed trials with Torino and Fiorentina
Worked as a banker for Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena, including in London, Zurich and Luxembourg
Completed Liceo classico in Figline Valdarno
Managed U.S.D. Cavriglia and U.S. Antella, taking both sides to Eccellenza
Joined minor side Tegoleto, then quit banking to coach full-time
Sansovino: promoted to Serie D in first season (2000-01); reached play-offs in last season
Sangiovannese: took the club to Serie C1 in first campaign (2003-04)
Alessandria: reached promotion play-offs and lost to Salernitana (2010-11 season)
Empoli: fourth place and playoff final (2012-13 season), lost to Livorno
Empoli: avoided relegation in 2014-15 Serie A
Napoli: runners-up to Juventus in 2015-16 Serie A
Napoli: second place in 2017-18 Serie A
Napoli: vetoed a like-for-like replacement of Gonzalo Higuain (summer 2016)
Mancini incident sanction: fined EUR 20,000 and banned for two Coppa Italia matches (2016)
Juventus: Coppa Italia runner-up (2019-20) and Supercoppa Italiana runner-up (2019)
